entities.summary: Matthew "Mackie" Samoskevich is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 24th overall by the Panthers in the 2021 NHL entry draft. He won the Stanley Cup with the Panthers in 2025.
